title: Weak Cosmic Censorship for Einstein–Vlasov
exact_target: Prove weak cosmic censorship for collisionless gravitating matter, especially in spherical symmetry.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30001361 (OWR-4129-003). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Mathematical Aspects of General Relativity (2009), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2009/46, pp. 2585--2646; official report source and mathematical context.
Official EMS Press PDF of the same Oberwolfach report; PDF pages 20--22.

status_qualification: Genericity, data topology, matter regularity, and the precise completeness formulation must be fixed in a proof. The source emphasizes that dust and scalar-field results cannot be transferred automatically to Vlasov matter; this is not a theorem for every initial datum without exceptional sets.
